stance_rationale: Selected canonical M4+IPCA_Hedge breaches the 600% annual turnover hard cap and embeds a future-frozen IPCA Gamma_beta in a 2004-2026 walk-forward schedule. The infeasibility report is transparent, but transparency is not approval.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: M4+IPCA_Hedge selected on LFC reduction and deferred Forge measurement, not on observed net_ir or cost-adjusted realized performance.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Reported cost is 8.8657 * 15bps * 2 = 266bps/year, but this cost is deferred to Forge and not used in selection.

critical_concerns.description: Selected canonical M4+IPCA_Hedge breaches turnover hard cap: reported IPCA one-way turnover is 8.8657/year and independently computed canonical M4 one-way turnover is 8.611/year, both above 6.0. Infeasibility disclosure does not convert a hard fail into approval.

weights.csv has 269 dates, but build_ipca_optimizer.R applies one Gamma_beta_freeze trained on 2021-2026 data across all 2004-2026 dates. This is a future-frozen risk model inside a walk-forward shell.
covariance.parquet is PSD, but post-shrink condition number is 399.6368, failing the requested cond <= 100 target. The package instead marks cond < 500 as pass without an explicit spec change.
Method selection is not net_ir or realized cost-adjusted performance. M4+IPCA_Hedge is selected before Forge measures SR/MDD/CAGR and despite 266bps/year estimated transaction cost.
Optimizer uses S1 weights as the alpha proxy, while alpha_scores.parquet is absent. Top-alpha realization and pure alpha_vector preservation cannot be independently verified.
lro_params SHA verification is inconsistent: risk reports self-match, optimizer recomputation fails, then proceeds using file mtime as indirect evidence. That is not a cryptographic freeze.
CRISIS fallback has cash overlay but no documented max_w contraction from 0.20 to 0.10, which the optimizer checklist requires for small-sample crisis regimes.

supporting_arguments: n_names, long-only, equity-plus-cash sum, and nominal 20% cap mostly pass on the canonical stage weights.
weights.csv is a multi-date schedule with 269 as_of_date values, so the defect is not a single-row file; the defect is the single future-estimated IPCA parameter set driving the historical schedule.
covariance.parquet independently verifies as symmetric PSD with min_eigenvalue 1.6296e-05, but fails the stricter cond <= 100 requirement.
